description: This file defines the SensorLogger class, which handles logging sensor data to a file in a Java project related to engine control and monitoring. It initializes a log file, writes headers, and appends sensor readings periodically based on sensor updates received via SensorCentral listeners.

classes.name: SensorLogger
classes.description: A utility class for logging sensor data from the engine control system into a file, including initialization, sensor data handling, and file writing.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the logger, sets up a sensor data listener that writes sensor readings to a log file when data updates occur.

methods.name: writeSensorLogLine
methods.description: Writes a line of current sensor values with a timestamp to the log file.

methods.name: startSensorLogFile
methods.description: Creates and opens the log file, writes headers, and prepares for sensor data logging, including retrieving debug mode and sensor names.

methods.name: getSensorName
methods.description: Returns the display name for a given sensor, possibly adjusted for debug mode.

methods.name: isPidDebugMode
methods.description: Determines if the current debug mode is a PID debug mode.
